Our address is at Endo Village, Nasarawa LGA, Nasarawa State, Nigeria (On-site)

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Heavy Duty Operators Trainer

Job Location: Endo Village, Nasarawa LGA - Nasarawa

Requirements

  "title": "Supply Chain Manager",
  "description": "Bakangizo Pharmacy and Stores is a proudly Nigerian, multi-service retail brand committed to meeting the everyday needs of our customers through quality products, excellent service, and community-focused operations. We operate a unique combination of businesses under one roof, making us a convenient and trusted destination for families and individuals alike.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Supply Chain Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute effective procurement and supply chain strategies.
	Oversee sourcing, purchasing, vendor selection, negotiations, and supplier relationship management.
	Analyse procurement costs, pricing trends, supplier performance, and purchasing patterns.
	Develop strategies to reduce procurement costs without compromising product quality.
	Ensure timely procurement and availability of products across branches.
	Coordinate procurement, warehousing, inventory planning, logistics, and distribution activities.
	Conduct supplier evaluations, market research, and cost-benefit analyses.
	Establish procurement budgets, performance indicators, and reporting systems.
	Identify supply chain risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
	Use data analytics to improve demand forecasting, purchasing decisions, and operational efficiency.
	Collaborate with Finance, Inventory, Warehouse, and Operations teams to improve overall supply chain performance.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
	Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, with substantial hands-on experience in procurement and supply chain management.
	A Master&#39;s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or any related discipline is mandatory.
	Experience studying outside Nigeria is an added advantage.
	Proven experience in a structured retail, FMCG, or large-scale distribution organisation.
	Exceptional analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into strategic business decisions.
	Strong procurement, negotiation, v\endor management, and cost optimisation skills.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, ERP systems, and analytical reporting tools.
	Strong commercial awareness, strategic thinking, and leadership capabilities.
	Professional certifications such as CIPS, CSCP, or related qualifications are an added advantage.

Supply Chain Manager Job at Bakangizo Pharmacy and Stores




        
    

        
        Bakangizo Pharmacy and Stores is a proudly Nigerian, multi-service retail brand committed to meeting the everyday needs of our customers through quality products, excellent service, and community-focused operations. We operate a unique combination of businesses under one roof, making us a convenient and trusted destination for families and individuals alike.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Supply Chain Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Develop and execute effective procurement and supply chain strategies.
	Oversee sourcing, purchasing, vendor selection, negotiations, and supplier relationship management.
	Analyse procurement costs, pricing trends, supplier performance, and purchasing patterns.
	Develop strategies to reduce procurement costs without compromising product quality.
	Ensure timely procurement and availability of products across branches.
	Coordinate procurement, warehousing, inventory planning, logistics, and distribution activities.
	Conduct supplier evaluations, market research, and cost-benefit analyses.
	Establish procurement budgets, performance indicators, and reporting systems.
	Identify supply chain risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
	Use data analytics to improve demand forecasting, purchasing decisions, and operational efficiency.
	Collaborate with Finance, Inventory, Warehouse, and Operations teams to improve overall supply chain performance.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
	Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, with substantial hands-on experience in procurement and supply chain management.
	A Master's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or any related discipline is mandatory.
	Experience studying outside Nigeria is an added advantage.
	Proven experience in a structured retail, FMCG, or large-scale distribution organisation.
	Exceptional analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into strategic business decisions.
	Strong procurement, negotiation, v\endor management, and cost optimisation skills.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, ERP systems, and analytical reporting tools.
	Strong commercial awareness, strategic thinking, and leadership capabilities.
	Professional certifications such as CIPS, CSCP, or related qualifications are an added advantage.

Mining Safety Manager Job at Diamond New Energy




        
    

        
        Diamond New Energy is also referred to as Ganfeng Lithium Industry Limited, which is a leading mining and mineral processing company based in Nasarawa State,Nigeria;with a core focus on the exploration, extraction, and processing of lithium. Our address is at Endo Village, Nasarawa LGA, Nasarawa State, Nigeria (On-site).

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Mining Safety Manager

Job Location: Endo Village, Nasarawa LGA - Nasarawa
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Requirements
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	MSc or Bachelor’s Degree in Geology, Mining Engineering, Occupational Health and Safety, or another related field.
	Strong knowledge of mining safety regulations, HSE standards, risk assessment, and hazard management.
	Proven experience developing and implementing Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) policies and procedures.
	Ability to conduct site safety inspections, audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments.
	Knowledge of mining equipment, drilling, blasting, excavation, and heavy-duty machinery safety.
	Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to train and supervise workers.
	Ability to develop and deliver safety training, toolbox talks, and emergency response procedures.
	Experience monitoring compliance with government regulations and company safety standards.
	Relevant professional HSE/Safety certification will be an added advantage.
	Must be willing to work on-site in Endo Village, Nasarawa LGA, Nasarawa State.
	Strong commitment to zero-accident culture, safety compliance, and continuous improvement.


Salary
N500,000 - N800,000 / month. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and credentials to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: For more enquires; contact: 08057840173, 08051286138 or WhatsApp: 08062129974.
